_comment: DK CAD Mobile release manifest. Lives in the dk_cad Pages repo ROOT as mobile-update.json; the app reads it from https://dheerajkum7g7-eng.github.io/dk_cad/mobile-update.json with the raw.githubusercontent copy as a mirror. The APK is stored as 2 MB PARTS because the publishing network's proxy rejects large authenticated uploads; GitHub does not join them, mobile.html does. To ship a new build: run publish-mobile.ps1, which rewrites version/size/sha256/partCount here. Keep this file SEPARATE from the desktop's update.json.
notes: Faster, steadier touch: pan/zoom no longer gets stuck. Offset tool. Delete one measurement instead of all. Automatic storage cleanup.
